purpose: new complete P2 controlled comparison; never complete or relabel old P2 v1/v2

environment.targetBuild: Release-derived terminaltest, non-debuggable, no mechanism overlay
environment.nativeGrid: 80 columns; hidden grid stable before IME; physical rows unchanged

matrix.conditionOrder: even round refresh-return, odd round return-refresh

endpoints.selection: first qualified attempt, first independently proven submitted attempt, first independently proven presented attempt; never borrow another token

aggregation.withinArm: median of all four formal windows for one case/condition in one launch pair
aggregation.betweenArms: candidate median divided by legacy median within that launch pair
aggregation.acrossPairs: median of four paired ratios, never a pooled-window ratio
aggregation.null: any formal null makes that arm median and the four-pair ratio null; no omission or imputation

gates.frameMetricsPolicy: BOTH_EXACT, ONE_EXACT or ABSENT retained as independent notification status; CONFLICT fails. Exact buffer and display chain mandatory regardless.

execution.settings: wait same-PID startup whole-settings write completion, configure once, retain persisted/flow/actual first LocalSettings guards
execution.nativeFailure: preserve all logs; stop outer launch matrix after the existing per-invocation fixed method inventory finishes
execution.identityFailure: preserve missing or unknown values and finish only the already fixed matrix; final integrity and adoption fail
